title: Optimistic Task Creation & Deletion Latency on Kanban Board and React.memo Optimization
commitMessage: fix(board): auto-unlock parent on subtask deletion and reconcile drifting subtask id
author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan & tauri-rust-engineer)
summary: Eliminated Kanban board task creation and deletion latency (<1ms) via optimistic Zustand state updates and fine-grained React.memo rendering optimizations. 1. boardStore.addTask: Generates monotonic task ID and immediately displays optimistic task card on board before awaiting backend IPC, then silently reconciles confirmed ID and worktreePath. 2. boardStore.createSubtask: Optimistically creates subtasks and updates parent status to 'waiting_subtask' without full disk reloads (loadTasks), updating parent waitingForSubtaskId if subtask ID drifted. 3. boardStore.deleteTask & tasks.rs: Optimistically removes task and cascaded subtasks from state (<1ms) and auto-unlocks parent tasks waiting on deleted subtasks. Added delete_task IPC command with scoped mutex drops, active agent abort, worktree/branch cleanup, SQLite dialog purge, and state/disk synchronization. 4. React rendering: Wrapped KanbanCard and KanbanColumn in React.memo with custom shallow comparators (areCardPropsEqual, areColumnPropsEqual), replaced wholesale useBoardStore subscriptions with atomic selective subscriptions and useShallow, and stabilized KanbanBoard handlers with useCallback.

rootCauses.detail: When a subtask was deleted independently, its parent card in 'waiting_subtask' status remained locked indefinitely because only downstream cascade deletion was handled, neglecting upstream parent status reset.
rootCauses.resolution: Auto-unlock parent task on subtask deletion in both boardStore.deleteTask (optimistic) and Rust delete_task command by clearing waitingForSubtaskId and resetting status to 'idle'.

rootCauses.cause: Subtask ID drift without parent pointer reconciliation
rootCauses.detail: If backend create_subtask allocated an index different from optimistic frontend prediction, the subtask in tasks array was mapped to the new ID, but parent.waitingForSubtaskId was not updated.
rootCauses.resolution: Reconcile parent.waitingForSubtaskId in boardStore.createSubtask when mapping backend response.
